messages.content:
You are a senior quant engineer planning. Produce ONLY labeled sections: PLAN, RISKS, CHECKPOINTS, IF_FAIL, DECISION_RULES. No prose outside.

Objective: Best way to excavate a maker/passive-execution strategy from existing Kalshi weather market data and link it to FV + flow gates.

State: Data live: 36M book snaps, 704k trades, 144k flow signals, 94k acted shadow, 80k settled. FV cells mostly unarmed (daily NO miscal). Flow rule gate just wired: micro_dev/aggression_w2m separate settlement PnL by 5-6c for buy_NO. fill_sim.py Stage0 offline only. DESIGN_maker: Stage1=passive entry on already-licensed trades; Stage2=2sided quote later. Engines only bet NO; taker pays 2-6c spread+fee.

Constraints: Shrink-only flow; no live maker until LEARNING→ARMED on pessimistic fills; reuse cell gate; no lower N_MIN; offline first.

Already tried: rare-event 1m/5m flow models never arm; settlement join proves feature value.

Respond only in the specified format.
